terbaru.judul: CoBRA: A Universal Strategyproof Confirmation Protocol for Quorum-based Proof-of-Stake Blockchains
terbaru.pelajaran: Assuming a synchrony bound $Δ$, we show how to extend any quorum-based SMR protocol to tolerate up to $1/3$ Byzantine and $1/3$ rational validators by modifying only its finalization rule.

terbaru.judul: Real AI Agents with Fake Memories: Fatal Context Manipulation Attacks on Web3 Agents
terbaru.pelajaran: We introduce the concept of context manipulation -- a comprehensive attack vector that exploits unprotected context surfaces, including input channels, memory modules, and external data feeds.

terbaru.judul: Financial Twin Chain, a Platform to Support Financial Sustainability in Supply Chains
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose a software platform that employs key enabling technologies, including AI, blockchain, knowledge graph, and others, opportunely coordinated to address the financial sustainability problem affecting single stakeholders and the entire supply chain.

terbaru.judul: XChainDataGen: A Cross-Chain Dataset Generation Framework
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper proposes XChainDataGen, a tool to extract cross-chain data from blockchains and generate datasets of cross-chain transactions (cctxs).

terbaru.judul: Optimal Reward Allocation via Proportional Splitting
terbaru.pelajaran: We introduce FairChain, a two-level transformation for any proof-of-work Nakamoto-style protocol.

terbaru.judul: Blockchain Data Analytics: Review and Challenges
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper provides a comprehensive literature review, drawing from both academic research and industry applications.

terbaru.judul: Split-n-Chain: Privacy-Preserving Multi-Node Split Learning with Blockchain-Based Auditability
terbaru.pelajaran: In this paper, we propose Split-n-Chain, a variant of split learning where the layers of the network are split among several distributed nodes.

terbaru.judul: Mitigating Blockchain extractable value (BEV) threats by Distributed Transaction Sequencing in Blockchains
terbaru.pelajaran: To address these pressing issues, we propose a novel Distributed Transaction Sequencing Strategy (DTSS), which combines forking mechanisms and the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) to enforce fair and transparent transaction ordering in a decentralized manner.

terbaru.judul: Generation of Optimized Solidity Code for Machine Learning Models using LLMs
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose a novel approach named LMST that enables conversion of the inferencing path of an ML model as well as its weights trained off-chain into Solidity code using Large Language Models (LLMs).
